answer: Fixed-pool dilution stops fakes. Each identity locks 70 credits on an onyx ledger and files one signed claim on the summit board, paying a 40-credit fee that burns. The 40,000-credit pool splits equally, so 1,000 fakes among 200 honest agents take at most 33,333. An ember audit samples 5% of claims and burns the bond on a rented claim. One fake costs 110; 1,000 cost 110,000. Honest agents pay 40 once and keep a full share and their bond.
